0.title: Getting Started
0.content:
## What is TEEEM?

TEEEM is a comprehensive construction management platform that helps you:
- Manage jobs from quote to completion
- Create and track construction schedules
- Generate purchase orders automatically
- Sync with your accounting software (Xero)
- Collaborate with your team
- Track project financials

## Quick Start (5 Minutes)

1. **Log in** to TEEEM
2. **Set up your company** (Settings > Company)
3. **Add contacts** (customers and suppliers)
4. **Create your first job**
5. **Import an estimate** or create one manually

## Navigation Overview

### Main Menu
- **Dashboard** - Your home screen with key metrics
- **Jobs** - All your construction projects
- **Contacts** - Customers, suppliers, subcontractors
- **Email** - Integrated email management
- **Tasks** - Action items and to-dos
- **Calendar** - Schedule and appointments
- **Settings** - System configuration

### Getting Help
- Click the **?** button (bottom-right) for contextual help
- Use **Take a Tour** for guided walkthroughs
- Search documentation with the search bar

1.title: Authentication & Users
1.content:
## Logging In

### Method 1: Email & Password

1. Navigate to your TEEEM URL
2. Enter your email and password
3. Click **Log In**

### Method 2: Login with Microsoft (Recommended)

1. Click **Login with Microsoft**
2. Authenticate with your Microsoft account
3. Approve TEEEM access (first time only)

**Benefits of Microsoft login:**
- Single sign-on convenience
- Automatic OneDrive integration
- Outlook email sync ready to go

## User Roles

| Role | Permissions |
|------|-------------|
| **User** | View jobs, access documents |
| **Manager** | Create jobs, manage team tasks |
| **Estimator** | Create and edit estimates |
| **Admin** | Full access, user management |
| **Super Admin** | System configuration |

## Password Reset

1. Click **Forgot Password?** on login page
2. Enter your email address
3. Check your inbox for reset link
4. Create a new strong password

2.title: System Administration
2.content:
## Settings Overview

Access settings via the gear icon in the sidebar.

### Personal Settings
- **Profile** - Your name, email, avatar
- **Preferences** - Theme, notifications, display options
- **Security** - Password, two-factor authentication

### Organization Settings (Admin only)
- **Company** - Business details, branding
- **Users** - Team member management
- **Integrations** - Xero, email providers, storage

## User Management

### Adding a New User

1. Go to **Settings > Users**
2. Click **Add User**
3. Enter email and name
4. Select role and permissions
5. Click **Send Invitation**

### Modifying User Permissions

1. Find user in the list
2. Click **Edit**
3. Adjust role or specific permissions
4. Save changes

3.title: Contacts & Relationships
3.content:
## Contact Types

- **Customers** - Your clients
- **Suppliers** - Material providers
- **Subcontractors** - Trade partners
- **Prospects** - Potential customers

## Adding a Contact

1. Go to **Contacts**
2. Click **Add Contact**
3. Fill in details:
   - Name and company
   - Email and phone
   - Address
   - Contact type
4. Click **Save**

## Linking Contacts to Jobs

Contacts can be linked to jobs as:
- **Client** - The customer for the job
- **Supplier** - Providing materials
- **Subcontractor** - Performing work

## Merging Duplicate Contacts

1. Select contacts to merge
2. Click **Merge**
3. Choose which record to keep
4. Review merged data
5. Confirm merge

4.title: Price Books & Suppliers
4.content:
## Price Books

Price books store your standard pricing for materials and labor.

### Creating a Price Book

1. Go to **Settings > Price Books**
2. Click **New Price Book**
3. Add items with:
   - Item code
   - Description
   - Unit price
   - Unit of measure

### Importing Prices

1. Click **Import**
2. Download the template CSV
3. Fill in your prices
4. Upload the file
5. Review and confirm

## Supplier Management

- Track supplier pricing
- Compare costs across suppliers
- Maintain supplier contacts

5.title: Jobs & Construction
5.content:
## Creating a New Job

1. Go to **Jobs**
2. Click **Add Job**
3. Enter job details:
   - Job name and code
   - Client (select from contacts)
   - Address
   - Job type and status
4. Click **Create Job**

## Job Tabs

- **Overview** - Summary and key dates
- **Documents** - Files and attachments
- **Emails** - Related correspondence
- **Schedule** - Gantt chart and tasks
- **Financials** - Budget and costs
- **Contacts** - Related people

## Job Statuses

| Status | Meaning |
|--------|--------|
| Quote | Preparing estimate |
| Pending | Awaiting client approval |
| In Progress | Active construction |
| On Hold | Temporarily paused |
| Complete | Finished |
| Cancelled | Job cancelled |

6.title: Estimates & Quoting
6.content:
## Creating an Estimate

1. Open a job
2. Go to **Estimates** tab
3. Click **New Estimate**
4. Add line items from price book
5. Adjust quantities and prices
6. Apply markup if needed
7. Generate PDF quote

## Estimate Sections

- **Materials** - Products and supplies
- **Labor** - Work hours and rates
- **Subcontractors** - Trade quotes
- **Allowances** - Provisional sums

## Sending Quotes

1. Review estimate totals
2. Click **Generate Quote**
3. Select template
4. Preview PDF
5. Email to client or download

7.title: AI Plan Review
7.content:
## What is AI Plan Review?

AI Plan Review uses artificial intelligence to analyze construction drawings and extract quantities, materials, and specifications.

## Using AI Plan Review

1. Upload construction drawings (PDF)
2. Select drawing type (floor plan, elevation, etc.)
3. Click **Analyze**
4. Review extracted data:
   - Room dimensions
   - Door/window counts
   - Material quantities
5. Import to estimate

## Supported Drawing Types

- Floor plans
- Site plans
- Elevations
- Sections
- Electrical layouts
- Plumbing diagrams

8.title: Purchase Orders
8.content:
## Creating a Purchase Order

1. Go to **Purchase Orders**
2. Click **New PO**
3. Select supplier
4. Add line items:
   - From price book, or
   - Manual entry
5. Set delivery details
6. Click **Create**

## PO Workflow

1. **Draft** - Being prepared
2. **Sent** - Emailed to supplier
3. **Acknowledged** - Supplier confirmed
4. **Delivered** - Goods received
5. **Invoiced** - Supplier invoice received

## Auto-Create from Bills

When a supplier invoice arrives without a PO:
1. System prompts to create PO
2. Review and approve
3. PO links to invoice automatically

9.title: Gantt & Schedule Master
9.content:
## Understanding the Gantt Chart

The Gantt chart shows your project timeline visually:
- **Tasks** listed on the left
- **Timeline** displayed on the right
- **Dependencies** shown as connecting lines

## Creating Tasks

1. Open job's **Schedule** tab
2. Click **Add Task**
3. Enter task details:
   - Name and description
   - Start and end dates
   - Assigned resources
4. Save

## Task Dependencies

Link tasks so one starts after another:
1. Select a task
2. Click **Add Dependency**
3. Choose predecessor task
4. Select dependency type:
   - Finish-to-Start
   - Start-to-Start
   - Finish-to-Finish

## Schedule Master

Schedule Master is the central scheduling view across all jobs:
- View all active tasks
- Filter by trade, job, or resource
- Drag to reschedule
- Resolve conflicts

10.title: Tasks & Checklists
10.content:
## Task Management

### Creating a Task

1. Go to **Tasks**
2. Click **Add Task**
3. Fill in:
   - Title
   - Description
   - Due date
   - Assignee
   - Priority
4. Optionally link to a job
5. Click **Create**

### Task Views

- **List** - Traditional task list
- **Board** - Kanban-style columns
- **Calendar** - Date-based view

## Checklists

Checklists are templates for recurring tasks:

1. Go to **Settings > Checklists**
2. Create checklist template
3. Add items
4. Apply to jobs as needed

## Supervisor Checklists

Daily site supervisor checklists ensure compliance:
- Safety checks
- Quality inspections
- Progress updates

11.title: Weather & Holidays
11.content:
## Weather Tracking

TEEEM tracks weather conditions that may affect your jobs:
- Daily weather data for job locations
- Weather delay logging
- Impact on schedule calculations

## Public Holidays

Holidays are factored into scheduling:

1. Go to **Settings > Holidays**
2. View/edit holiday calendar
3. Holidays auto-apply to schedules

### Holiday Settings

- **National holidays** - Pre-configured
- **State holidays** - Location-based
- **Company holidays** - Custom dates

## Weather Delays

When weather affects work:
1. Open the job
2. Go to **Schedule**
3. Click **Log Weather Delay**
4. Enter delay details
5. Schedule adjusts automatically

12.title: OneDrive Integration
12.content:
## Connecting OneDrive

1. Go to **Settings > Connections**
2. Find **OneDrive/SharePoint**
3. Click **Connect**
4. Sign in with Microsoft account
5. Authorize TEEEM access

## Automatic Folder Creation

When you create a new job, TEEEM automatically:
- Creates a folder in OneDrive
- Uses your folder template structure
- Names it with the job code

## Uploading Documents

1. Open a job
2. Go to **Documents** tab
3. Drag files to upload, or
4. Click **Upload** and select files

## Folder Templates

Configure folder structure in **Settings > Storage**:
- Define subfolders (Plans, Photos, Contracts)
- Set naming conventions
- Apply to all new jobs

13.title: Email Integration
13.content:
## Overview

TEEEM's email integration allows you to:
- Connect multiple email accounts (IMAP)
- Sync emails automatically
- Link emails to jobs and contacts
- Send emails directly from TEEEM
- Create email rules for auto-filing

---

## Connecting an Email Account

### Supported Providers

TEEEM supports any IMAP email provider:
- **Gmail** - Google Workspace or personal Gmail
- **Outlook/Microsoft 365** - Office 365 or Outlook.com
- **Webcentral** - Australian hosting provider
- **Other IMAP** - Any provider with IMAP access

---

## TEEEM Email Hosting

Don't have business email? TEEEM can provide hosted email for your team.

### Pricing Options

| Option | Price | What You Get |
|--------|-------|-------------|
| **Branded Email** | $5/month per mailbox | Use your own domain (e.g., you@yourcompany.com.au) |
| **TEEEM Email** | $3/month per mailbox | Use @teeem.com.au (e.g., you@teeem.com.au) |

### Branded Email (Own Domain)

If you own a domain name, we can set up professional email:
- **Example:** info@smithbuilders.com.au
- Full IMAP/SMTP access
- Works with any email client
- We handle the technical setup
- **$5/month per mailbox**

**Requirements:**
- You own the domain name
- Access to update DNS records (we'll guide you)

### TEEEM Email (@teeem.com.au)

Need email but don't have a domain?
- **Example:** john.smith@teeem.com.au
- Professional email address
- Full IMAP/SMTP access
- **$3/month per mailbox**

### Getting Started

Contact us to set up hosted email:
- Email: support@teeem.com.au
- Or ask your account manager

---

## Connecting Your Own Email

### Step-by-Step Setup

1. Go to **Email** in the sidebar
2. Click **Add Email Account**
3. Select your provider (or choose 'Other')
4. Enter your credentials:
   - **Email address** - your full email
   - **Username** - usually same as email
   - **Password** - your email password or app password
5. Click **Test Connection**
6. If successful, click **Save**

### Gmail Setup

**Important:** Gmail requires an App Password, not your regular password.

1. Go to Google Account > Security
2. Enable 2-Factor Authentication (if not already)
3. Go to App Passwords
4. Generate a new app password for 'Mail'
5. Use this 16-character password in TEEEM

**IMAP Settings (auto-filled):**
- IMAP Server: imap.gmail.com
- IMAP Port: 993 (SSL)
- SMTP Server: smtp.gmail.com
- SMTP Port: 587 (TLS)

### Outlook/Microsoft 365 Setup

1. Select 'Outlook' as provider
2. Enter your Microsoft email
3. Enter your password
4. Settings auto-fill:
   - IMAP: outlook.office365.com:993
   - SMTP: smtp.office365.com:587

### Webcentral Setup

1. Select 'Webcentral' as provider
2. Enter your email and password
3. Settings auto-fill:
   - IMAP: mail.webcentral.com.au:993
   - SMTP: mail.webcentral.com.au:587

---

## Email Sync

### Initial Sync

After connecting, TEEEM syncs your recent emails:
- Downloads last 30 days by default
- Syncs all folders (Inbox, Sent, etc.)
- Runs in background

### Manual Resync

To force a resync:
1. Go to **Email**
2. Click the **Sync** button (circular arrows)
3. Wait for sync to complete

### Sync Settings

- **Sync interval** - How often to check (default: 15 min)
- **Sync period** - How far back to sync
- **Folders** - Which folders to include

---

## Email Features

### Reading Emails

1. Select an account from the sidebar
2. Browse folders (Inbox, Sent, etc.)
3. Click an email to read
4. View attachments inline

### Composing Emails

1. Click **Compose** button
2. Enter recipients (To, CC, BCC)
3. Add subject and message
4. Attach files if needed
5. Click **Send**

### Linking to Jobs

Emails can be linked to jobs for better organization:
1. Open an email
2. Click **Link to Job**
3. Select the job
4. Email now appears in job's Email tab

---

## Email Rules

Create rules to automatically process incoming emails:

### Creating a Rule

1. Go to **Email > Rules**
2. Click **Add Rule**
3. Set conditions:
   - From address contains...
   - Subject contains...
   - Has attachment
4. Set actions:
   - Move to folder
   - Link to job
   - Apply label
5. Save the rule

### Example Rules

- **Supplier invoices**: If from "@supplier.com" and subject contains "invoice" → Link to job, move to Invoices folder
- **Client emails**: If from client contact → Auto-link to their job

---

## Blacklist

Block unwanted senders:

1. Go to **Email > Settings > Blacklist**
2. Click **Add to Blacklist**
3. Enter email address or domain
4. Future emails from this sender are hidden

---

## Troubleshooting

### Connection Failed

**Check:**
- Email and password are correct
- App password used for Gmail
- IMAP is enabled in your email settings
- Firewall allows IMAP connections

### Emails Not Syncing

**Try:**
1. Click the Sync button to force sync
2. Check sync status in account settings
3. Verify IMAP folders are selected
4. Check for sync errors in the log

### Authentication Errors

**Common causes:**
- Password changed - update in TEEEM
- App password expired - generate new one
- Account locked - check email provider

### Sync Errors

If an account shows sync errors:
1. Go to Email settings
2. Find the account with error
3. Click **Test Connection**
4. Review error message
5. Update credentials if needed

14.title: Chat & Communications
14.content:
## Team Chat

TEEEM includes built-in team messaging:

### Channels
- **#general** - Company-wide announcements
- **#team** - Internal discussions
- Custom channels for projects

### Direct Messages
Private conversations with team members:
1. Click **Messages** in sidebar
2. Click **New Message**
3. Select recipient
4. Start chatting

## SMS Integration

Send text messages to contacts:
1. Open a contact
2. Click **Send SMS**
3. Compose message
4. Click **Send**

**Note:** SMS requires Twilio integration setup by admin.

15.title: Xero Accounting
15.content:
## Connecting Xero

1. Go to **Settings > Connections**
2. Find **Xero**
3. Click **Connect**
4. Sign in to Xero
5. Authorize TEEEM

## What Syncs

- **Contacts** - Customers and suppliers
- **Invoices** - Sales invoices
- **Bills** - Purchase invoices
- **Payments** - Payment records

## Invoice Sync

When you create an invoice in TEEEM:
1. Invoice auto-syncs to Xero
2. Payment status updates automatically
3. No double-entry required

## Troubleshooting

### Sync Issues
1. Check connection status in Settings
2. Refresh Xero connection
3. Check for sync errors

### Duplicate Records
- Use merge feature to combine
- Set matching rules in settings

16.title: Payments & Financials
16.content:
## Payment Tracking

Track payments received and made:

### Recording a Payment

1. Open the invoice or bill
2. Click **Record Payment**
3. Enter amount and date
4. Select payment method
5. Save

## Job Financials

View job financial summary:
- **Contract value** - Total job value
- **Invoiced** - Amount billed
- **Received** - Payments received
- **Costs** - Expenses and POs
- **Profit** - Calculated margin

## Reports

- Accounts receivable aging
- Accounts payable summary
- Job profitability
- Cash flow projection

17.title: Workflows & Automation
17.content:
## What are Workflows?

Workflows automate repetitive tasks based on triggers:
- When job status changes
- When invoice is created
- When task is completed

## Creating a Workflow

1. Go to **Settings > Workflows**
2. Click **New Workflow**
3. Set trigger event
4. Add actions:
   - Send email
   - Create task
   - Update field
   - Notify user
5. Save and activate

## Example Workflows

### New Job Notification
- **Trigger:** Job created
- **Action:** Email team with job details

### Invoice Follow-up
- **Trigger:** Invoice overdue 7 days
- **Action:** Send reminder email to client

18.title: Custom Tables
18.content:
## Custom Data Tables

Create your own data tables for specific needs:
- Equipment tracking
- License management
- Custom registers

## Creating a Custom Table

1. Go to **Settings > Custom Tables**
2. Click **New Table**
3. Define columns:
   - Text, number, date
   - Dropdown choices
   - Lookup to other tables
4. Set up views and filters
5. Start entering data

## Using Custom Tables

- Access from sidebar
- Filter and sort data
- Export to Excel
- Link records to jobs

19.title: Corporate Module
19.content:
## Corporate Overview

The Corporate Module manages company structures:
- Multiple companies and groups
- Directors and officers
- Shareholders and ownership
- Compliance tracking

## Company Structure

### Adding a Company

1. Go to **Corporate**
2. Click **Add Company**
3. Enter company details:
   - Legal name and ACN/ABN
   - Registered address
   - Company type
4. Save

### Company Groups

Organize related companies into groups:
- Parent/subsidiary relationships
- Shared resources
- Group reporting

20.title: Corporate Extended
20.content:
## Directors & Officers

Track company leadership:
- Current and past directors
- Appointment dates
- Responsibilities

## Shareholders

Manage share registers:
- Shareholder details
- Share classes
- Ownership percentages
- Transaction history

## Compliance Calendar

Never miss a deadline:
- ASIC annual reviews
- Financial year reporting
- Regulatory filings
- Custom reminders

## ASIC Integration

Connect to ASIC for:
- Company searches
- Document lodgement
- Change notifications

21.title: Work Health & Safety
21.content:
## WHS Overview

Manage workplace health and safety:
- Incident reporting
- Site inspections
- Inductions
- SWMS (Safe Work Method Statements)

## Incident Reporting

1. Go to **WHS > Incidents**
2. Click **Report Incident**
3. Fill in details:
   - Date, time, location
   - People involved
   - Injury/damage details
   - Witnesses
4. Add photos if needed
5. Submit

## Site Inspections

Conduct regular safety inspections:
1. Use inspection checklists
2. Record findings
3. Assign corrective actions
4. Track completion

## SWMS

Create Safe Work Method Statements:
- High-risk work procedures
- Hazard identification
- Control measures
- Required sign-offs

22.title: Customer Portal
22.content:
## Portal Overview

Give customers secure access to their project info:
- View job progress
- Review quotes
- Pay invoices
- Send messages

## Setting Up Portal Access

1. Open a contact
2. Click **Portal Access**
3. Set permissions:
   - Which jobs to see
   - What tabs to access
4. Send invitation email

## Customer Experience

Customers can:
- View project photos and updates
- Download documents
- Approve quotes online
- Make payments
- Message your team

23.title: File Warehouse
23.content:
## File Warehouse Overview

Central document storage across all your data:
- All job documents
- Email attachments
- Contact files
- Corporate documents

## Navigating Files

1. Go to **Warehouse** in sidebar
2. Browse folder structure:
   - Jobs/[Job Code]/[Category]
   - Contacts/[Contact Name]
   - Emails/[Year]/[Month]
3. Click to preview or download

## Uploading Files

1. Navigate to destination folder
2. Drag files to upload, or
3. Click **Upload** button
4. Files are auto-organized

## Search

Find files across all locations:
1. Use search bar at top
2. Search by filename or content
3. Filter by date or type
4. Click result to open

24.title: E-Signatures
24.content:
## E-Signature Overview

Get documents signed electronically:
- Quotes and proposals
- Contracts
- Variations
- Compliance forms

## Sending for Signature

1. Open a document
2. Click **Send for Signature**
3. Add signers:
   - Name and email
   - Signing order (if sequential)
4. Place signature fields
5. Send

## Tracking Status

View signature progress:
- **Sent** - Awaiting signature
- **Viewed** - Recipient opened
- **Signed** - Signature complete
- **Declined** - Recipient declined

## Completed Documents

After signing:
- Original + signed version stored
- Audit trail recorded
- Notifications sent

25.title: Data Warehouse & Reports
25.content:
## Reporting Overview

Generate insights from your data:
- Pre-built reports
- Custom report builder
- Scheduled reports
- Data export

## Standard Reports

- Job profitability
- Accounts receivable aging
- Task completion
- Team productivity
- Sales pipeline

## Custom Reports

1. Go to **Reports > Builder**
2. Select data source
3. Choose columns
4. Add filters
5. Set grouping/sorting
6. Save report

## Scheduled Reports

Automate report delivery:
1. Open a report
2. Click **Schedule**
3. Set frequency (daily/weekly/monthly)
4. Add recipients
5. Reports email automatically
